report.clinical_summary: The patient has been managing a chronic illness (likely HIV) with Triumeq for three years. They experience fatigue and headaches that worsen when they skip doses. They sometimes skip doses when feeling well or when life is hectic at work. They have a nagging worry about long-term effects of not being consistent, and they have occasional nausea and stomach discomfort as side effects. They feel isolated at times due to the illness and work-life balance challenges.
